children: Groupe Dynamite lifted its full-year guidance after second-quarter profit and revenue rose, driven by strong customer demand across its Garage and Dynamite store banners.
The Canadian fashion retail company on Thursday raised its guidance for the full year. The company now expects total revenue growth of 25% to 27%, up from a previous range of 22% to 25%,
Comparable store sales expectations were also increased, the lower end of the range lifted to 12% from 11%, and the top end of 14% remaining the same.
Adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization margin is now expected to be between 39.5% and 40.5%, compared with previous guidance of between 38.5% and 39.5%.

The upgrade follows a second quarter where the company reported a rise in net earnings to 113.4 million Canadian dollars ($82.1 million), or C$1.00 a share, for the three months ended Aug. 1, compared with C$63.9 million, or C$0.56 a share.
Groupe Dynamite, which operates under the two banners Garage and Dynamite, reported adjusted earnings were C$0.96 a share. According to FactSet, analysts were expecting C$0.80 a share.
Revenue increased by nearly 29.8% to C$423.6 million, topping forecasts of C$401.7 million.
Comparable sales in the quarter were up 10.3%, which on a constant currency basis was 12.3%, compared with comparable sales growth of 28.6% a year earlier.
